consequence.statement: Applications or configurations that depend on interim resources being included in Argo CD's synchronization or status operations will now exclude those resources by default, potentially changing application visibility or sync behavior.

original.statement: Argo CD 3.0.0 now excludes known interim resources by default, a breaking change that may affect environments relying on interim resources being included in synchronization or status.

decision.reason: [ev-849d17802e96] and [ev-9e62d58cc85e] show the change adds default entries to resource.exclusions in argocd-cm, and [ev-f4ec83261cc7]/[ev-e302b0a6bff7] name the excluded types (Endpoints/EndpointSlices, Kyverno reports/UpdateRequest, TokenReview/SubjectAccessReview types, CSR/CertificateRequest, Cilium internals). The stated reason is to reduce UI clutter and churn. Nothing says anything fails, is rejected or must be migrated. Argo CD keeps working but no longer shows or tracks those types, so behavior-change (review) is the right kind.
